items.rationale: The failed indoor supply pipe is treated as covered under §2.4.3(a), with like-for-like materials allowed under §§7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9. Case 39 supports about €42 for one short pipe section, €24 for sealing and €22 for insulation, or €88 gross.

Section 7.1.7(g) covers customary labour for the time reasonably needed to open the wall and replace the pipe. For this localized repair, one installer hour at €76 plus one nine-hour technician block at about €82 per hour, benchmarked to Case 39, gives about €814 gross.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows one travel charge per contractor per invoice regardless of the number of visits. This is the only such line on the repair invoice; Case 39 supports €65 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and one equipment deployment charge per drying operation. The comparable bathroom-wall drying charge in Case 39 supports about €405 gross.

items.description: Close and repaint the wall opening
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the access opening and repainting the disturbed patch, not the unaffected bathroom. Case 39 supports about €420 gross for the combined work.
